Separates inspected findings, unverified claims, and tentative hypotheses with packet provenance and no silent joins.

Uses the lean brief spine, asks no question, and closes exactly.
Leaves all durable state unchanged.

Separates findings, claims, hypotheses, conflicts, and sources per account without cross-account joins.
